note: Completion record for a campaign whose runner-emitted rollup predates the completion of one rep. The runner artifact (campaign-gate-summary.json) is deliberately NOT overwritten: it is the authentic output of the run that produced it, and rewriting it to say pass would erase that a rep failed.
sequence: Campaign ran 9 reps. 8 passed. spring-hibernate-rep-3 failed at the DB seed (exit 70, the seed fail-closed added the same day) and produced no gate, so the rollup correctly refused to certify the campaign: campaign_gate_status=not_evaluated, exit 1.
Root cause of that seed failure was NOT flaky infrastructure: the box Postgres was internet-exposed and had been accessed; the postgres role password had been altered. Remediated in commit 56e3e95.

spring-hibernate-rep-3 was then re-run standalone. That first re-run overlapped a Maven build on the same box, so although its numbers matched the clean reps exactly it was discarded as uncontrolled and re-run again with the box idle.
The rep-3 artifacts in this directory are from the second, clean re-run.
caveat: durability_tier_uniform in the runner artifact reads false only because the absent rep reported an unknown tier. All nine reps are T2-fsync-node-durable-postgres.
